description: Check an llms.txt file against the llmstxt.org proposal (v2, August 2026) before you publish it or rely on one. Send the file text (up to 20,000 characters). Get back whether it follows the proposal's structure: the H1 title first, the blockquote summary, the details part with no headings, H2 sections holding file lists, each item a markdown link [name](url) with optional ': notes', and the Optional section; every fault with its line number and what to change; warnings for things the proposal does not forbid but agents trip on (plain http links, relative links, empty sections). The title, section names and link counts are given back; link targets are not fetched. Answer fields: ok, verdict, result, rule, does_not, sources, observation, signature, verify. Errors: ok false with the reason (bad input, too large, hourly limit). Free. No model, no network, nothing you send is stored by the tool, and every answer is signed with LLPRO's key (check it at https://llpro.ai/llms-txt-check). Not legal, tax or financial advice.

llms_txt.description: The llms.txt file text (markdown; line breaks CRLF, LF or CR), up to 20,000 characters. Nothing is fetched: send the text.
